title: Postage Schedule — Restoration Mailing Charge on Paper Certificates (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
When a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate is restored by a reinstatement filing, the restoration mailing charge follows how the certificate travels to the state and the calendar days left from today to the filing's SR-26 effective date.

| How the certificate travels | Calendar days left from today to the filing's SR-26 effective date | Restoration mailing charge |
|---|---|---|
| Paper mail | 5 or fewer | 24.50 (courier) |
| Paper mail | More than 5 | 9.85 (certified mail) |
| Electronically | Any | None |

How a certificate travels is its transmission method in the certificate's timetable. The days left are counted in calendar days from today to the SR-26 effective date shown on the filing's record.

## Both sides of the window (hypothetical dates)

| Today | SR-26 effective date | Days left | Paper-mail certificate | Electronic certificate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 15 June | 5 | 24.50 | None |
| 10 June | 16 June | 6 | 9.85 | None |
| 10 June | 11 June | 1 | 24.50 | None |

## Notes

- Exactly 5 days left is within the courier window.
- An electronically transmitted certificate carries no restoration mailing charge however many days are left.
